hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qi 'insights'; then report="$HOME/.claude/usage-data/report.html"; if [ -f "$report" ]; then d=$(stat -f '%Sm' -t '%Y-%m-%d' "$report"); dest="$HOME/.claude/usage-data/report-${d}.html"; [ ! -f "$dest" ] && command cp "$report" "$dest"; fi; fi; exit 0

if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'git (commit|push)'; then branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$branch" ]; then case "$branch" in feature/*|bug/*|bugfix/*|dev|main|master) exit 0 ;; *) echo "Branch '$branch' does not follow naming convention (feature/*, bug/*, bugfix/*). Create a properly named branch first." >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; fi; fi; exit 0
filepath="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; case "$filepath" in *.go) gofmt -w "$filepath" 2>/dev/null; dir=$(dirname "$filepath"); go vet "$dir/..." 2>&1 | head -20 || true ;; esac; exit 0
filepath="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; case "$filepath" in go.mod) dir=$(dirname "$filepath"); cd "$dir" && go mod tidy 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac; exit 0

filepath="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; case "$filepath" in *.ts|*.js|*.html|*.css|*.scss) dir="$filepath"; while [ "$dir" != "/" ]; do dir=$(dirname "$dir"); if [ -f "$dir/.eslintrc.json" ] || [ -f "$dir/.eslintrc.js" ] || [ -f "$dir/.eslintrc.yml" ] || [ -f "$dir/eslint.config.js" ] || [ -f "$dir/eslint.config.mjs" ]; then cd "$dir" && npx eslint --fix "$filepath" 2>&1 | head -20 || true; break; fi; done ;; esac; exit 0
